verdict.rationale: First-party docs state Bevy is free and open source forever under the MIT or Apache 2.0 licenses, with the explicit aim that developers can see into their tools. A runtime crates.io probe independently confirms the 'MIT OR Apache-2.0' license, and the GitHub repository and the browsable example source show the code is publicly readable. Missing for 10: no hands-on evidence describing navigation or completeness of the full engine source tree in the repository.
